purpose: Records (a) which catalogs were searched during discovery and (b) NON-HuggingFace resources referenced by discovery. Reference resources are URL-verified but are NOT candidate training datasets.

catalogs_searched.name: Hugging Face dataset cards (raw README)
catalogs_searched.method: raw README.md fetch for intended-use / provenance prose

catalogs_searched.name: GitHub
catalogs_searched.method: repository search via discovery queries + HTTP reachability of cited repos
catalogs_searched.used_for: official dataset repositories and reference implementations

catalogs_searched.name: arXiv
catalogs_searched.method: citation links from dataset cards (arXiv IDs recorded as paper_url)

catalogs_searched.name: Kaggle
catalogs_searched.used_for: secondary mirrors only; primary source preferred

catalogs_searched.name: Microsoft REDSTONE (data-source methodology)
catalogs_searched.method: methodology review (large-scale quality filtering), not raw-data ingestion

reference_resources.name: Microsoft REDSTONE
reference_resources.notes: Large-scale data-quality filtering methodology. Reviewed for pipeline design (quality scoring, filtering stages); NOT a training dataset, no raw text is taken from it.

reference_resources.name: SWE-bench official site
reference_resources.notes: Official leaderboard/entry point for the SWE-bench family.

reference_resources.name: GLUE Benchmark
reference_resources.notes: Official GLUE leaderboard and task definitions.

reference_resources.name: SuperGLUE Benchmark
reference_resources.notes: Official SuperGLUE leaderboard and task definitions.

reference_resources.name: Belebele repository
reference_resources.notes: Official Belebele code/paper entry point. Confirms test-set intent.

reference_resources.name: XTREME repository
reference_resources.notes: Official XTREME benchmark repository (index into component datasets).

reference_resources.name: VLSP official portal
reference_resources.notes: Vietnamese Language and Speech Processing shared-task portal. Dataset access usually requires registration => license/eligibility audit before use.

reference_resources.name: BioASQ challenge
reference_resources.notes: Official BioASQ biomedical QA challenge site; participation terms govern the data.
